note: PRs 111, 103 and 115 on the Base PS5: the WebUI lists the PC's shares and saves the guest share; RetroArch opens a .7z on the share through its file layer, extracts the ROM (its CRC matches the file on the PC) and runs it.
must_contain: the file on the PC: CRC32 0x41852f72
human_check: Load Content > SMB, choose a .7z: the game starts.
